note: Triennial election of the rural district councillors, polled Thursday 2 June 1955. All 19 divisions were uncontested; names from the Fermanagh Herald's full nomination list (4 June 1955, p. 8). Returned unopposed.
correctionNote: Renamed from 'Churchill' to Church Hill (19 Nov 2026, w19-tidy, the owner's decision 4 of 19 Nov 2026: a division filed under two spellings takes its official name, and each round keeps the spelling it was filed under as Constituency_Name_As_Printed): the Northern Ireland DED maps of 1921-69 name the DED Church Hill; the rounds were filed as Churchhill (1924, 1927, 1930, 1936, 1939, 1946, 1961, 1964); Churchill (1933, 1949, 1952, 1955, 1958). This round was filed as 'Churchill', kept as Constituency_Name_As_Printed; the old address (churchill) answers with a redirect to this one.
